name: MistyClimate Agent
description: This is a agent created using mistral models

paragraphs: This is an advanced multi-agent system created using Mistral models, designed to process climate-related documents, analyze images, perform JSON data analysis, and convert text to speech. It provides a comprehensive climate intelligence platform with document processing, image analysis, JSON analysis, and text-to-speech functionalities, all integrated into a user-friendly Gradio interface.
features: Specialized Climate Intelligence: Interact with an AI assistant trained on climate science and sustainability topics
Expert Guidance: Get accurate information on climate change, environmental policies, and sustainability practices
Interactive Interface: User-friendly chat interface with emoji avatars and sample questions
Climate Document Analysis: Extract structured data from climate-related PDFs using OCR capabilities
Multi-format Support: Process various document types including climate reports, analysis papers, and data sheets
